To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The most important factors in microarray data analysis are the experimental design and the quality of the raw data.
(1) the best current practices are those that have been published by experts in the field and (2) that there is a need to develop a new generation of tools that can be used by non-experts.

(i) the use of multiple microarray platforms is necessary to obtain a comprehensive view of gene expression; (ii) the analysis of microarrays is not trivial; (iii) the analysis of gene expression is not trivial, but it can be made easier with the use of a few basic principles; and (iv) there is no one best analysis method, and the choice of the method should be guided by the specific biological question.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of methods for microarray analysis and the application of these methods to the study of human disease.
the development of methods to analyze gene expression data, in particular microarray data.
the analysis of microarrays, and with the development of tools to facilitate the analysis of micro- and mega-scale genomic data.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the analysis of microarrays should be done by experts in bioinformatics and statistics, and that researchers should not attempt to analyze their microarray data without such expertise.
the best practice in microarray analysis is to use multiple methods and approaches, to validate results, to use the most recent technologies and to be open to the latest developments in the field.
microarrays are a powerful tool for gene expression analysis.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the analysis of gene expression microarray data is a very complex problem, and there is no one best way to solve it.
we are developing a framework that allows for the systematic analysis of large-scale biological experiments.
microarray technology has matured to the extent that we now can reliably detect changes in the expression levels of genes in biological systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that

it is possible to obtain reliable and reproducible results with the current microarray platforms, but that the results are not necessarily as good as the best results obtained with the best technologies.
there are many ways to analyze microarrays, and that it is very difficult to know which method is best for a particular dataset, or for a particular biological question.
there is a need for a new generation of tools that will allow the researcher to perform a complete analysis in a single package.
